column1: # C->Lua event fire sites of the 3.3.5a client (WoW.exe build 12340): every direct call in `.text` to
# FrameScript_SignalEvent (0x81b530) and its world-live guarded wrapper (0x5326d0). Both forward
# `(eventId, arg_format, varargs)` to the formatter at 0x81ac90. There are no tail jumps to either.
# `dyn`/`?` is deliberately conservative: objdump established instruction boundaries, but a value was
# computed or its defining push lay across a control-flow boundary. It is not filled from another client.
# A blank arg_format is a literal null pointer and therefore zero Lua arguments; `?` is unresolved.
# Sites in 0x4d7000..0x4e5fff use the separate 41-slot GlueXML registry at
# 0xb6aff8; their names stay blank rather than being falsely resolved through the world table.
# 1082 callsites; 1055 literal event ids; 836 literal format pointers (including null).
